init_weights: init weights of a PyTorch model using ResNet style initialization for Conv2d, Linear, and BatchNorm layers
compute_precise_bn_stats: compute precise batch normalization statistics on training data by accumulating mean and variance across minibatches
get_flat_weights: get all model weights as a single flat vector by concatenating parameter tensors into one column vector
set_flat_weights: set all model weights from a single flat vector by copying values back into each parameter tensor
model2adj: extract model weights and masks as a dictionary of numpy arrays for Linear, Conv2d, and custom layer types
